title: Undo and redo your changes
summary: Take back your last saved change and put it back, one step per saved change, with your own list of steps.
roles: Anyone who may make the change

title: See an object's changes and undo one
summary: The History tab of an object lists when, who and what changed, with before and after, and Undo this change takes one back.
roles: Anyone who may view the project; undo needs permission to make the edit

title: The History place: every change in the project
summary: A History place listing every change in the project; in E1 but not reachable from the screen yet.
roles: Anyone who may view the project

title: Chat about an object: mentions, links, replies and likes
summary: Discuss an object on its Chat tab: @mention a colleague, #link an object, reply, like, edit, delete and resolve.
roles: Reviewer role or above with an Editor or Reviewer license to write; Engineer and above to resolve

title: Give someone a task
summary: Ask a person to do something about an object, with a due date; they see it in the Inbox and mark it done.
roles: Engineer and above to create; the assignee may always mark it done

title: The Inbox: mentions, replies and tasks
summary: The bell on the left rail shows your unread notices and opens the Inbox with its views Assigned to me, Mentions, I assigned and All.

title: Choose which notices come by email
summary: In Settings, choose for mentions, replies and tasks whether they also come by email.

title: Pin a message on a drawing and mark it Needs review
summary: Pin a numbered chat message on a 2D space; the object shows Needs review until the message is resolved.
roles: Anyone who may write in the chat; Engineer and above to resolve

title: Attach files to an object or a project
summary: Keep PDFs, spreadsheets and drawings with an object or a project, with a PDF preview.

title: See others' changes live
summary: Several people on one project see each other's changes within seconds, without reloading.
roles: Everyone with a role on the project

title: When two people change the same thing
summary: The first change is kept, the second is refused with a clear message and the copy is reloaded.

title: See who else has a sheet open
summary: Avatars at the right of a 2D space's toolbar show who else has it open, with a pencil while they edit; a click lists them with their role, Viewing or Editing, and since when.
roles: Everyone with a role on the project

title: Messages (direct messages)
summary: Direct messages between people; not connected yet.

title: Branches: work apart, then push your changes
summary: Planned: your own working copy of part of the design, with pull, conflict resolution and push.
roles: Editor license to work in a branch (part of the license, no add-on); Reviewer license to look, compare and approve

title: Merge requests, branch types and branch permissions
summary: Planned: merge requests reviewed by a colleague, branch types, automatic resolution rules and push and approval permissions.
roles: Editor license (part of the license, no add-on); Reviewer license to review and approve when asked

title: A task's checklist
summary: A task can have a checklist: items to tick in the Inbox, the same as in E1 Reviewer on the iPad.
roles: Ticking: the task's assignee or anyone who may edit it; editing the items: who may edit the task
